definitions.indexedPresence: Engine-specific indexed URL evidence from URL Inspection or webmaster report; an HTTP 200 alone is insufficient.
definitions.searchRanking: Position for a specified query, engine, time, locale and result surface; selected tool results do not establish absolute rank.
definitions.brandMention: Foundation named in an answer, with or without a link; record separately from citation.
definitions.sourceCitation: Answer explicitly links a Foundation URL as support; retain the answer passage and actual resolved citation URL.
definitions.referralTraffic: Observed inbound visits in authorized analytics/server evidence, including attribution limits; not inferred from mentions or citations.

procedure: Run the exact prompts in fresh independent sessions on each available supported search-enabled surface. Do not seed the Foundation name, feed candidate content, or substitute this implementation chat for observations.
Record UTC time, provider/product/model label, locale, login/personalization state, search mode, prompt ID and exact prompt. If a surface is unavailable, mark not measured, not zero.

Keep full answer and screenshot/export in approved private storage. Record evidence reference, mention boolean, cited URLs, excerpt supporting each citation and resolved host. Null means unavailable; false requires an observed answer.
Associate each cited page with the production commit at observation time. Record the candidate release time only after authorized publication. Preserve mixed-version/crawl-lag uncertainty.

Repeat weekly on the same surfaces and settings after publication; compare like-for-like observations. Summarize citations as cited observed answers / observed answers per product with sample size. Do not treat this small sample as a visibility score or causal ranking gain.
Keep Search Console indexing/performance, ordinary search results and referral traffic in separate datasets; do not combine them into a fabricated score.
